analysis.contrarian: EVERYONE is focused on: Iran escalation/ceasefire binary, oil prices, defense stocks, and gold. What is being MISSED: (1) DAL earnings on April 8 is a high-conviction SHORT—jet fuel up 103% and Delta doesn't hedge, yet stock only down 3% YTD. Smart money (put/call 1.60) sees it but equity hasn't caught up. (2) LLY Foundayo launching TODAY is drowned out by war headlines—a $100B+ TAM product launch with $149/month pricing is a distinct non-war catalyst. (3) Breadth divergence (S&P up 3.4% over 5d but 0% above 200 DMA) is extreme—ceasefire relief rally could be a bull trap. (4) March CPI on April 10 will first capture Iran energy effects—could be a nasty upside surprise. (5) CEG/nuclear down 35% from highs while AI datacenter thesis unchanged—contrarian long developing.
